notes:
Lead: VP Product (Rita Gomez). Mid-market SaaS that provides a multi-tenant agent layer for SMB customers (helpdesk automation + orchestrated actions). Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first for speed of integration; explicit path to Dedicated for tenant isolation and predictable QoS.

POC goals:
 - Validate streaming stability for 1k concurrent user sessions (target p95 stream delta < 350ms).
 - Tool calling latency: end-to-end invocation with external webhooks <= 300ms median.
 - Per-tenant quotas: baseline 50 RPS per tenant, burst policy to 250 RPS for premium tenants; fair-share enforcement required.
 - Cost sensitivity: wants to understand token-based vs. seat-based pricing for bursty agent workloads; target ARR cost <= $0.015/token-equivalent in steady state.

Recent POC notes:
 - 2026-02-10 intro call (ff_2026_02_10_0192): agreed to 2-week POC focusing on streaming reliability and tool calling.
 - 2026-02-24 demo: saw good p50 latency for Hosted API but intermittent dropped streams at higher concurrency. SE observed increased reconnects when KV-cache warmups coincide with burst traffic.
 - 2026-03-03 stress run (ff_2026_03_03_4417): identified hotspot on shared batching queue; recommended partitioned worker pools and tenant-aware batching.

Quote pulled from VP Eng on demo: "Streaming drops unacceptable for paid customers — need 99.9% success on long-lived streams."

Security & compliance: currently SOC2 in progress, SSO/SAML in place, contractually require EU data residency for several pilot customers. Interested in KMS integration and audit log export to their SIEM.

Commercial: initial forecast ~Q2 2026. Prefers Hosted to accelerate time-to-value; open to Dedicated with reserved capacity commit if pricing supports predictable unit economics. Wants explicit SLA for streaming (uptime + per-request success) and clear overage model for per-tenant bursts.

Next actions: SE to share streaming stress harness repo and run with Redwood Dedicated config; AE to send pricing worksheet with Dedicated vs Hosted breakouts; legal to start drafting data residency addendum if POC passes stability bar.
